Article Title: 'Rahul's mohabbat ki dukan': BJP slams Congress' tributes to anti-Sikh riots accused Sajjan Kumar
Article Text:
Sajjan Kumar was sevring life imprisonment in Delhi's Tihar Jail

NEW DELHI: The BJP on Friday hit back at the Congress after several of its leaders paid tribute to former party leader Sajjan Kumar, a convict in a 1984 anti-Sikh riots case, who died at 80 Congress MP Deepender Hooda described the death of Kumar, a former three-term Lok Sabha MP, as an "irreparable loss.""Today, the country's political landscape has suffered an irreparable loss... Sajjan Kumar ji was a leader whose connection with people in Delhi and across north India was cited as a model across the country," he said.Reacting to Hooda's remarks, BJP spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari accused the Congress of "eulogising the killers of the Sikh community", referring to Kumar's role in the anti-Sikh riots."Congress calls late Sajjan Kumar, a man convicted in a 1984 anti-Sikh riots case, a 'role model'! How can Congress eulogise the killers of our Sikh community?" Bhandari posted on X."This is the real mindset of 'Mohabbat Ki Dukkan' (shop of love) of Rahul Gandhi and exposes the innate hate Congress has for the Sikh community!" Bhandari added, referring to a phrase used by Congress leader and leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha.The BJP spokesperson further demanded that Congress apologise for "insulting" the victims of the anti-Sikh riots and "rubbing" salt into the wounds of the survivors and victims' families.Congress leader Udit Raj also described Kumar's death as a "great loss" for the party."It is a great loss for the Congress. He was a very senior Congress leader, and it will be difficult to fill the void... He did a lot of work, especially for the poor," Raj stated.Sajjan Kumar died at Delhi's Safdarjung Hospital on Thursday."Sajjan Kumar was brought to Safdarjung Hospital by police with altered sensorium around 11 am. He was immediately admitted and resuscitation measures were initiated. Despite providing all necessary medical and life-support measures, he could not be saved and passed away at 12:30 pm," the hospital's statement read."He was a known case of high blood pressure and Parkinson's disease and had a history of multiple hospital admissions in the past," the statement added.Kumar was serving multiple life sentences after his conviction in cases linked to the 1984 anti-Sikh riots in Delhi.He was sentenced to life imprisonment by the Delhi High Court on December 17, 2018, in a case related to the killing of five Sikhs and the burning of a gurdwara during the anti-Sikh riots.He was also sentenced to life imprisonment by a Delhi court in February 2025 in another case relating to the killing of two Sikh men during the riots.Kumar resigned from the primary membership of the Congress after the 2018 conviction.
Article Summary: Congress MP Deepender Hooda described the death of Kumar as an "irreparable loss" BJP spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari accused the Congress of "eulogising the killers of the Sikh community" Kumar was serving multiple life sentences after his conviction in cases linked to the 1984 anti-Sikh riots in Delhi.

Article Title: 'Why this abnormal gap?' Congress questions delay in prorogation of Monsoon Session
Article Text:
Congress MP Jairam Ramesh questions delay in formal closure of Monsoon Session

Monsoon Session awaits formal closure

NEW DELHI: The Congress on Sunday questioned the “abnormal” delay in proroguing the Monsoon Session of Parliament , noting that the time gap between adjournment and prorogation is generally two to four days, but the Monsoon Session is yet to be prorogued after being adjourned on August 13.Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh questioned whether the delay was because Union Home Minister Amit Shah was still looking for a two-thirds majority to get the delimitation-linked Constitutional amendment bill passed in a special session.The government, for its part, has denied any plans to convene a special session."The time gap between the adjournment of the Lok Sabha sine die and its prorogation is generally two to four days - although there are many instances when adjournment and prorogation have taken place on the very same day. Ten days have gone by since this Lok Sabha was adjourned sine die but still there is no information on its prorogation," Ramesh posted on X.He acknowledged that the Monsoon Session in 2015 was prorogued 28 days after adjournment and the gap in 2021 was 20 days. However, there were no "diabolical moves afoot then," the Congress Rajya Sabha MP added.Ramesh linked the delay to the possibility of the Centre calling a special session to pass a major legislation, possibly the Delimitation Bill."What explains the abnormal delay now? Is the Union Home Minister still in search of his बहुकलंकित 2/3rd majority to get the Constitutional Amendment Bill on Delimitation passed in a Special Session?" he asked.The Monsoon Session of Parliament began on July 20 and was adjourned sine die on August 13, its scheduled last day. It was largely washed out amid an impasse between the government and the Opposition over issues including the alleged Delhi Police brutality against students during their march to Parliament on the first day of the session and the alleged theft of donations at the Ram Temple in Ayodhya.Ramesh's post comes as the prorogation notification for the Monsoon Session had not been issued as of Sunday morning, meaning it is yet to formally end.According to constitutional provisions, the President convenes and prorogues Parliament sessions on the recommendation of the government.Speculation over the Centre's next move on the delimitation-linked Women's Reservation Bill has continued after Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay raised the issue at the August 21 Southern Zonal Council meeting in Mahabalipuram, chaired by Shah.“I urge the Union government to provide a clear legislative assurance that no state will suffer a reduction in its percentage of representation in Parliament on account of its success in population stabilisation,” Vijay said.His remarks indicated a shift from the categorical opposition to delimitation expressed through the resolution he moved in the Tamil Nadu Assembly on August 12.However, Karnataka chief minister DK Shivakumar, who also attended the Mahabalipuram meeting, demanded that the central government retain the existing number of Lok Sabha seats — 543 — for the next 25 years.
Article Summary: Monsoon Session of Parliament began on July 20 and was adjourned sine die on August 13, its scheduled last day. The time gap between adjournment and prorogation is generally two to four days. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh questioned whether the delay was because Union Home Minister Amit Shah was still looking for a two-thirds majority.

NEW DELHI: Posters portraying Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi as the “real-life Batman” have been put up outside the Congress headquarters in Delhi.The posters feature the message, “The silent guardian, a watchful protector. LoP Rahul Gandhi, the real life batman.”Earlier this month, Rahul Gandhi launched an “Ask Me Anything” session inviting young people to question him on topics ranging from student protests and education to politics and philosophy. Announcing the initiative on X, Gandhi wrote, “Students, Gen-Z -- I'm here to listen.Ask me anything on Instagram, and I'll answer as many questions as I can.” One of the questions asked, “Are you Batman?” Gandhi appeared to play along with the long-running social media meme comparing him to the fictional superhero.“Let’s just say that no one has ever seen me and Batman in the same room together,” Rahul replied.The Congress later shared video clips featuring several of Rahul’s responses from the session. Rahul Gandhi also posted a video of himself standing in the rain with the theme music from The Dark Knight playing in the background, further fueling the Batman reference that gained attention on social media.Rahul Gandhi’s outreach to Gen Z comes as political leaders increasingly use social media platforms to engage with younger audiences and expand their digital reach.Meanwhile, Rahul Gandhi staged a five-hour protest outside the Parliament Street Police Station on Friday, demanding an FIR and justice for 19-year-old Sahil Lochab, who suffered pellet injuries during a police crackdown at the July 20 student protest at Jantar Mantar.Rahul arrived at the police station around 11.30 am with Lochab, his mother and their lawyer, and was later joined by Congress general secretary Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and other party leaders. He also met the Deputy Commissioner of Police and other senior officers at the DCP office in Connaught Place.The Delhi Police subsequently registered a case in connection with the incident.
Article Summary: Posters portraying Rahul Gandhi as the ‘real-life Batman’ have been put up outside the Congress headquarters in Delhi. The posters feature the message, “The silent guardian, a watchful protector. LoP Rahul Gandhi, the real life batman.”

Article Title: 2 MLAs among six injured in accident
Article Text: New Delhi: Six people, including two MLAs, were injured after a Swift collided with an Innova near the PWD office in central Delhi late Sunday. Police said the Swift, driven by 32-year-old Ashutosh Pandey, hit a divider, crossed the railing and rammed into the Innova. Kirari MLA Anil Jha and Karnataka MLA Abhay Patil were among those injured. Pandey, his wife and two children were also hurt. All sustained minor injuries and are stable.
Article Summary: A Swift, driven by 32-year-old Ashutosh Pandey, hit a divider, crossed the railing and rammed into the Innova. Kirari MLA Anil Jha and Karnataka MLA Abhay Patil were among those injured. Pandey's wife and two children were also hurt.

Article Title: Hit-and-run in Vasai: Two women injured as speeding car hits their two-wheeler
Article Text: Vasai: Two women were injured after a speeding car rammed into their two-wheeler in Vasai West late on Saturday night. The car driver fled the spot following the accident, which was captured on a CCTV camera.The incident occurred around 11.45 pm on the Vasai-Bhuigaon road in the Giriz-Dongri area of Vasai West. The two women were travelling on a two-wheeler when a car coming from the opposite direction at high speed collided with their vehicle.Both the woman riding the two-wheeler and the pillion rider sustained serious injuries. Local residents rushed to the spot after the accident and shifted the injured women to a nearby hospital for treatment.The CCTV footage of the accident is now being examined by the police to identify the vehicle and its driver.“We have received information about the incident. Further investigation is underway and the process of registering a case is in progress,” said Saurabhi Pawar, senior police inspector, Vasai police station.
Article Summary: The incident occurred around 11.45 pm on the Vasai-Bhuigaon road in the Giriz- Dongri area of Vasai West. The two women were travelling on a two-wheeler when a car coming from the opposite direction at high speed collided with their vehicle.

Article Title: Senior citizen from Maharashtra loses Rs 6 lakh in SIR fraud
Article Text: Vasai: An elderly man from Virar West was allegedly duped of Rs 6 lakh by cyber fraudsters who contacted him on the pretext of verifying his details under the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process.The 71-year-old complainant, a resident of Agashi in Virar West, received a call from an unknown mobile number on Wednesday afternoon. The caller told him that the SIR verification process was underway and that his name did not match that of his father in the records.The caller then sent him a link and asked him to transfer Rs 5 to correct the discrepancy. The complainant followed the instructions and made the payment. However, the fraudster claimed that the transaction had failed and asked him to download a third-party application.After downloading the application, the complainant entered his bank details as instructed. Within a short time, Rs 6 lakh was siphoned off from his bank account.Following the incident, the complainant approached Bolinj police station in Virar, where a case of fraud was registered against an unidentified person.This is reportedly the first cyber fraud case in the Mira-Bhayandar, Vasai-Virar (MBVV) police commissionerate involving the SIR pretext.
Article Summary: A 71-year-old man from Virar West was allegedly duped of Rs 6 lakh by cyber fraudsters. Fraudsters contacted him on the pretext of verifying his details under the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process. This is reportedly the first cyber fraud case in the Mira-Bhayandar, Vasai-Virar police commissionerate involving the SIR pretext.

Article Title: ​​Former Sena minister Sattar holds closed-door discussion with Jarange
Article Text:
Former Shiv Sena minister Abdul Sattar (right) with quota activist Manoj Jarange

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar:





Former minister and Sillod MLA Abdul Sattar on Saturday met Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange at Antarwali Sarathi in Jalna district, holding a closed-door discussion for nearly an hour ahead of Jarange’s proposed agitation from Aug 29.The meeting assumes significance as Jarange has recently intensified attacks on deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde and other Mahayuti politicians over the Maratha reservation issue, accusing govt of failing to honour its promises.However, Sattar sought to downplay political speculation surrounding the visit. “I have come here as a friend, not as a politician. Manoj Jarange is my friend. I came to meet him personally,” he said.Sattar, considered close to Shinde, said Jarange raised several issues concerning Maratha reservation and farmers during the discussion. “I will convey the demands directly to the chief minister and both deputy CMs. My request is that my visit should not be politicised,” he said.Jarange, meanwhile, reiterated that the Aug 29 agitation would go ahead unless govt addressed key demands of the Maratha community.“Govt should hand over us data showing that 58 lakh Kunbi certificates were issued in the first place.I am talking of issuing certificates and not merely finding Kunbi records. Those who have applied for Kunbi certificates or caste validity certificates must get certificates before Aug 28,” he said.The quota activist accused govt of failing to act despite being given ample time. “Instead of taking concrete actions, you are betraying us,” he said.Jarange recently targeted Shinde over the reservation issue and also criticised Sena minister Sanjay Shirsat and BJP minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule.Notably, Sattar is not the first senior Sena functionary to reach out to Jarange. Industries Minister Uday Samant had also met the activist in April amid efforts to engage with the ongoing reservation movement.
Article Summary: Former minister and Sillod MLA Abdul Sattar met Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange at Antarwali Sarathi in Jalna district. The meeting assumes significance as Jarange has recently intensified attacks on deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde and other Mahayuti politicians over the Maratha reservation issue.

Article Title: CM Fadnavis corners Rahul over Women’s Reservation Bill
Article Text:
CM Devendra Fadnavis

Nagpur:





Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis on Sunday accused Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi of “double standards” on women’s empowerment, alleging that he speaks about women’s rights from public platforms, but Congress opposes and votes against the Women’s Reservation Bill.“The most revolutionary step towards empowering women is the Women’s Reservation Bill brought by PM Narendra Modi . But Rahul Gandhi and Congress voted against it. He does not want to give women their rights. He comes to Pune and speaks about women’s empowerment, but there is a clear contradiction between his words and actions. This reveals Gandhi’s double standards,” the CM said.Fadnavis praised a programme organised in Nagpur on Sunday to take a dig at the ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ event held in Pune the other day. “More than 25,000 youngsters participated in the Nagpur event. No vehicles were arranged to ferry them, and no money was paid to anyone. The youngsters came here on their own,” Fadnavis said. He added that the Nagpur event was intended to give young people the “right direction” as they would eventually contribute towards building a developed India.The CM also criticised Congress, saying the party is full of “Bol Bachchan netas” who have lost connection with the grassroots.“The party merely issues statements, does nothing more,” he said.Referring to the ongoing electoral roll exercise, Fadnavis said the first phase had been completed, and “doubtful” cases would be re-examined before the final list is prepared. Citing his own constituency, Fadnavis said the rolls contained over 23,000 names of deceased electors and around 20,000 duplicate entries.Fadnavis said such discrepancies need to be corrected. He also referred to the role of Booth Level Agents (BLAs), saying all political parties should participate in identifying errors and ensuring genuine electors are not excluded. He stressed that the exercise should ultimately ensure that not a single voter is left out.On tribal welfare, Fadnavis said Maharashtra was implementing what he described as Adivasi Swayam Yojana. When hostel accommodation is unavailable, the state provides ₹60,000 each to around 20,000 tribal students towards lodging, boarding and educational expenses, he said.
Article Summary: Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis accused Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi of “double standards” on women’s empowerment. He said Congress opposes and votes against the Women's Reservation Bill. The CM also criticised Congress, saying the party is full of ‘Bol Bachchan netas’

Article Title: Man commended for returning lost bag containing ₹1.75 lakh in Coimbatore
Article Text:
Coimbatore:





A local resident handed over a misplaced bag containing ₹1.75 lakh in cash to the police, which was subsequently restored to its rightful owner on Saturday night.According to police sources, Vijayanand, 39, of Five Corner, who runs a stamp pad shop nearby, spotted an unattended bag lying on the road in front of the Jain Temple on Variety Hall (VH) Road around 8.45pm. On inspecting the bag, he found it contained ₹1.75 lakh in cash. He immediately handed the bag at the B-3 Variety Hall Road police station.Roughly an hour later, Nirmal Rawel, a trader from Erode district, arrived at the same police station to lodge a complaint regarding his missing cash bag. After verifying his credentials and confirming the details of the lost money, officers confirmed the bag belonged to him and handed it over.Meanwhile, G Karthikeyan , deputy commissioner of police (DCP - South), commended Vijayanand for his civic responsibility and honesty, citing his action as an inspiring example for the public.
Article Summary: Vijayanand, 39, of Five Corner, spotted an unattended bag lying on the road in front of the Jain Temple on Variety Hall (VH) Road around 8.45pm. On inspecting the bag, he found it contained ₹1.75 lakh in cash. He immediately handed the bag at the B-3 Variety Hall Road police station. Nirmal Rawel, a trader from Erode district, arrived at the same police station to lodge a complaint regarding his missing cash bag.

Article Title: Driver claims link to top cop after car hits, injures boy
Article Text:
A 12-year-old boy was hit by a car near Karuppayurani in Madurai on Sunday, triggering outrage among local residents after the driver allegedly claimed he was a relative of a top police official.





Madurai: A 12-year-old boy was hit by a car near Karuppayurani in Madurai on Sunday, triggering outrage among local residents after the driver allegedly claimed he was a relative of a top police official.According to police, a speeding car rammed a couple and their 12-year-old son, who were travelling on a two-wheeler along the Pandi Kovil-Sivaganga Road near Appar Higher Secondary School around 8.30 pm. The boy suffered a leg injury and was rushed to a hospital where his condition is stable.Residents and passersby chased and intercepted the car, and handed over the driver to the police. Soon after, a video surfaced on social media showing the driver telling those at the scene that he is a relative of a top ranked police official, sparking further arguments. Police have registered a case and are investigating.
Article Summary: A 12-year-old boy was hit by a car near Karuppayurani in Madurai on Sunday. The boy suffered a leg injury and was rushed to a hospital where his condition is stable. The driver allegedly claimed he was a relative of a top police official. Police have registered a case and are investigating.

Article Title: 4 held with 83 strips of Tapentadol tablets in Madurai
Article Text:
Four men were arrested on Saturday for allegedly possessing Tapentadol tablets for sale in Madurai city.

Madurai

:





Four men were arrested on Saturday for allegedly possessing Tapentadol tablets for sale in Madurai city.Police identified them as Kesava Kumar alias Sethu, 26, of Sivaganga, Mugilan, 23, of Ramanathapuram district, Gokul Krishnan , 23, and Madhan , 24.A patrol team spotted the four near the Muthiah Temple bus stop at Kochadai during checks against narcotic substances. Police said they tried to flee on seeing the team but were intercepted.A search led to the seizure of 83 strips of Tapentadol tablets and three mobile phones. Police said preliminary inquiries indicated that the tablets were being kept for sale.Madakulam police registered a case and arrested the four. They were later remanded in judicial custody. Further investigation is underway.
Article Summary: Four men were arrested on Saturday for allegedly possessing Tapentadol tablets for sale in Madurai city. Police identified them as Kesava Kumar alias Sethu, 26, of Sivaganga, Mugilan, 23, of Ramanathapuram district, Gokul Krishnan, 23, and Madhan, 24.

Article Title: HC quashes criminal case against students who protested against anti-Sanatan Dharma meet
Article Text:
HC quashes FIR against students





Madurai: Madras high court quashed criminal cases registered against students who had protested against the conduct of the Sanatan Dharma eradication conference in Madurai district in 2023.“The petitioner and others raised their agitation in a peaceful and democratic manner and further, there is no allegation of any damage to any public property,” said Justice R Vijayakumar, quashing the case.He also observed that the petitioner and others, who belonged to a students association, had conducted a protest in front of a conference hall, where a meeting was conducted for eradication of Sanatan Dharma. In such circumstances, continuation of the criminal proceedings would only be an abuse of process of law.The other accused persons also stand on the same footing, the judge observed and quashed the FIR not only as against the petitioner, but also against other persons.The court was hearing a petition filed by M Senthoorvelan seeking to quash the FIR registered against him by the Tallakulam police in Madurai in 2023.The case of the prosecution is that the petitioner along with seven others belonging to a students association staged a protest against the conduct of a conference for eradication of Sanatan Dharma. Despite warnings given by police, he and others blocked the road and caused inconvenience to the general public.Counsel submitted that the petitioner was a student of law and that he had raised his objection with regard to the conduct of such a meeting. Noting that they had peacefully protested in front of the conference hall, he said it could not be considered to be an offence.On his part, the govt advocate submitted that though the charge sheet was ready, it has not been filed before the court so far.
Article Summary: Madras high court quashes criminal cases registered against students who had protested against the conduct of the Sanatan Dharma eradication conference in Madurai district in 2023. “The petitioner and others raised their agitation in a peaceful and democratic manner and further, there is no allegation of any damage to any public property,” said Justice R Vijayakumar.

Article Title: Paramakudi DSP suspended after wife’s harassment complaint
Article Text:
Paramakudi deputy superintendent of police (DSP) Y Jaffer Siddique was placed under suspension on Friday following a complaint by his wife alleging harassment over his alleged extramarital affair.

Madurai

:





Paramakudi deputy superintendent of police (DSP) Y Jaffer Siddique was placed under suspension on Friday following a complaint by his wife alleging harassment over his alleged extramarital affair.According to sources, when Siddique was serving in the Vellore region, his wife lodged a police complaint alleging that he was in an extramarital relationship and harassed her when she questioned him. Vellore district police subsequently registered a case against him.On Friday, a CB-CID investigating officer questioned Siddique at Paramakudi. He was later placed under suspension. Further investigation is underway.In a separate case, the Tirunelveli All Women Police registered a case on Friday against Arunkumar, inspector of Veeravanallur police station, for allegedly harassing a woman with whom he was in an extramarital relationship. He was subsequently placed under suspension.
Article Summary: Paramakudi deputy superintendent of police (DSP) Y Jaffer Siddique was placed under suspension on Friday following a complaint by his wife. Siddique's wife lodged a police complaint alleging that he was in an extramarital relationship and harassed her when she questioned him.

Article Title: Two riders killed after bike rams into steel railing in Madurai district
Article Text:
AIADMK cadres led by former minister R Kamaraj protest in Trichy against the TVK govt over not waiving off agricultural loans and indifference shown on the Mekkadatu issue and failing to protect state water rights.





Madurai: Two men were killed after their two-wheeler collided with a roadside steel railing near Chinna Udaippu village in Madurai district on Saturday.Police identified the deceased as M Pandidurai, 22, and M Muneeswarar, 21, residents of Aruppukottai in Virudhunagar district. They were working as construction workers in Thiruppalai in Madurai district. On Saturday morning, they were travelling on a two-wheeler to attend a temple festival at their native place, police said.When they were near Chinna Udaippu village, their vehicle rammed into a roadside steel railing. Both Pandidurai and Muneeswarar died on the spot, police said.Avaniyapuram police sent the bodies to Govt Rajaji Hospital for postmortem. They registered a case and are investigating.
Article Summary: M Pandidurai, 22, and M Muneeswarar, 21, were working as construction workers in Thiruppalai in Madurai district. On Saturday morning, they were travelling on a two-wheeler to attend a temple festival at their native place. Their vehicle rammed into a roadside steel railing.

Article Title: Lady doctor arrested near Salem for illegal fetal gender determination
Article Text: SALEM: Police on Wednesday arrested a lady doctor in Vazhapadi in Salem district on charges of illegally determining and disclosing the gender of fetuses to pregnant women. Health department officials seized scan equipment, abortion pills and cash from a clinic the doctor, Selvamba Rajkumar, was running in the area. They sealed the clinic.Authorities said the clinic on the Cuddalore Road charged pregnant women additional fees to reveal the gender of the unborn child.Acting on a complaint, a team led by joint director Dr S P Nandhini, Attur district health officer Dr N Yoganand and Vazhapadi Government Hospital chief medical officer Dr Ramesh Kumar raided the facility.They found that Dr Selvamba Rajkumar had received Rs 30,000 from a pregnant woman to determine the gender of her fetus. Dr Nandini said the doctor had been handed over to police for legal proceedings.Health department officials said this was not the first violation by the clinic. It had been raided twice earlier, and Dr Selvamba Rajkumar had faced restrictions on conducting scans and treatments, they said. Cases were registered against her then too.
Article Summary: Health department officials seized scan equipment, abortion pills and cash from a clinic the doctor, Selvamba Rajkumar, was running. Authorities said the clinic on the Cuddalore Road charged pregnant women additional fees to reveal the gender of the unborn child. Dr Nandini said the doctor had been handed over to police for legal proceedings.

Article Title: Assets of MDMA wholesaler under excise lens
Article Text:
Kochi

:





The excise department has begun an investigation into the finances of Varun Dev who was arrested with MDMA on Saturday. The accused, an alleged wholesale supplier of MDMA, was allegedly sourcing drugs from Delhi and distributing them in the city, often using young women as carriers to avoid detection.Excise sources said that the accused was a kingpin of drug peddling operations who rarely gets involved in physical transactions. “Most of his associates were arrested in NDPS case and are in prison. So, he was forced to directly involve. He has amassed assets through drug trade,” said an official.He said that an investigation is also on into how he trapped young women into becoming his carriers. “We suspect that the gang used to befriend women and stash contraband in their belongings without even their knowledge. Another key associate of the accused is also in our radar and he would be arrested soon,” said the official.Acting on information that Dev had arrived in Kochi allegedly to finalise a drug deal, the team tracked his vehicle and intercepted it in the Vyttila area after a chase. They recovered 232g of MDMA concealed beneath the steering wheel.Vipin S Kumar, 30, who was allegedly accompanying Dev, was arrested. The vehicle was taken into custody.
Article Summary: The excise department has begun an investigation into the finances of Varun Dev who was arrested with MDMA on Saturday. The accused, an alleged wholesale supplier of MDMA, was allegedly sourcing drugs from Delhi and distributing them in the city, often using young women as carriers to avoid detection.

Article Title: Probe ordered into Onam celebration by ED-attack case accused
Article Text:
Thiruvananthapuram

:





The ADGP (law and order) has ordered an inquiry into the Onam celebrations and reel-making allegedly involving accused persons in the Enforcement Directorate (ED) attack case outside the Museum police station in Thiruvananthapuram.The special branch assistant commissioner has been asked to ascertain whether there was any lapse on the part of police personnel in allowing the accused, who are CPM leaders, to conduct the celebrations and shoot reels in front of the station. The ADGP has directed that strict action be taken if any negligence is established.The celebrations and reel shoot were reportedly led by former CPM councillor and ED attack case accused I P Binu. The accused were seen shooting reels while sitting on a swing arranged by police in front of the station. The swing had been installed near the floral decoration prepared by police as part of the Onam celebrations.Police have also initiated steps to approach the court seeking cancellation of Binu’s bail.
Article Summary: The ADGP (law and order) has ordered an inquiry into the Onam celebrations and reel-making allegedly involving accused persons in the Enforcement Directorate (ED) attack case. The special branch assistant commissioner has been asked to ascertain whether there was any lapse on the part of police personnel.
